description: Rename a workspace, set or clear its product_url, or pause/resume every monitor in it. Send only the fields to change; nothing is written if any field is invalid. Pausing keeps all history, so prefer it over delete_workspace. To pause one competitor, use update_competitor.

name.description: New workspace name. Cannot be blank.

product_url.description: Your own product's URL (e.g. example.com). Pass null to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

status.description: paused stops checks on every monitor in the workspace; active resumes them

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

name: update_workspace
title: Update workspace
